name: The Village at Orange
description: The Village at Orange is an upscale lifestyle shopping center located in the heart of Orange County, featuring a carefully curated mix of specialty retailers, dining options, and services. This open-air center provides a sophisticated shopping experience with Spanish-inspired architecture and pedestrian-friendly walkways. The center serves the affluent communities of Orange, Tustin, and surrounding areas with premium retail offerings.
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in Orange County offering specialty retail, dining, and services in a Mediterranean-inspired setting.
